title: Heat-spreader results and exact evidence in Wright
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated Heat-spreader comparison proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open workflows
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows in the workspace activity bar.

manualSteps.label: Choose process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow. Select the saved heat-spreader workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Reopen the recorded run from its workspace link.

manualSteps.label: Inspect outputs
manualSteps.instruction: Inspect Results and checks, then open the revision 60 fine-temperature CSV.

manualSteps.label: Inspect samples
manualSteps.instruction: Expand View numerical samples. Choose x_m, y_m and temperature_c as the horizontal, vertical and value columns.

manualSteps.label: Inspect assessment
manualSteps.instruction: Close representation, then click Open assessment on that same field result.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the heat workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted heat workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted heat workflow is listed.

steps.label: Heat workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original heat assignment opens with its connected review, CAD and analysis stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted heat workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted heat diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved heat source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual heat run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded heat run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Actual CAD and solver outputs
steps.summary: The working view exposes all eighteen recorded engineering outputs and the held assessment.
steps.purpose: Verify resumed results survive the earlier review checkpoint.
steps.expected: Eighteen actual CAD, solver and assessment outputs.
steps.actual: All eighteen exact results are visible.

steps.label: Actual numerical field table
steps.summary: The fine-grid temperature field opens as the exact CSV table.
steps.purpose: Verify actual solver data is inspectable.
steps.expected: Actual numerical rows and temperature column.
steps.actual: The exact CSV numerical table is rendered.

steps.label: Actual field samples
steps.summary: The numerical view projects all 765 supplied fine-grid samples on explicitly selected axes.
steps.purpose: Present actual numerical field data without inventing geometry.
steps.action: Expand View numerical samples and choose x_m, y_m and temperature_c.
steps.expected: All 765 supplied samples with numerical evidence and projection limitation.
steps.actual: The exact field samples are rendered; other coordinates remain in the table.

steps.label: Current assessment evidence
steps.summary: The exact current validator assessment opens from its actual field result.
steps.purpose: Inspect the checked requirements and held human review.
steps.action: Click Open assessment on the revision 60 fine-grid result.
steps.expected: Exact full assessment evidence, including 25 passed checks and one held review.
steps.actual: The actual recorded assessment is open.

steps.label: Exact assessment focus
steps.summary: Evidence navigation retains the specific producing result even when one assessment checks several outputs.
steps.action: Inspect the focused field result after opening its assessment.
steps.expected: Focus remains on the revision 60 fine-grid result.
